title: Moblin Gear

{{Infobox Item |image= File:BotW Moblin Club Icon.png |caption= A [[Moblin Club]] |pronunciation= |plural= |type= |game= BotW |other= AoC |cost= |value= |location= |uses= {{List| * Attacking [[Enemy|Enemies]] * Defense }} |strength= |durability= |comp= |sample= |theme= }} The {{Term/Store|Moblin Gear|Moblin Gear|BotW, AoC, Series}} is a recurring archetype of [[Weapon]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 174}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Moblin Gear is a variety of equipment wielded by [[Moblin]]s, which occurs in three tiers of increasing strength and durability. It includes only two types of [[Weapon]]s, spears and two-handed clubs. Regular Moblin Gear is typically wielded by basic Moblins and is created by crudely carving [[Tree]]s into shape. It has low [[Durability]] due to the poor quality of its construction.{{Cite|{{Big|Moblin Club}}
A crudely fashioned club favored by Moblins. It's carved from a sturdy tree but is sloppily made, so it breaks easily.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Moblin Spear}}
This wooden spear is most often used by Moblins. It's made from a hastily whittled tree, so its stabbing power and durability are both pretty low.|Inventory|BotW}} Moblin Gear with the "Spiked" modifier is a stronger tier of weaponry typically used by [[Blue Moblin]]s. It is strengthened through the use of [[Animal]] bones, giving it greater Durability and damage output.{{Cite|{{Big|Spiked Moblin Club}}
Animal bone has been affixed to this Moblin club to greatly improve its damage.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Spiked Moblin Spear}}
This Moblin-made spear uses a horned animal bone as the spearhead. Like many Moblin weapons it's sloppily made, but this one packs some respectable piercing power.|Inventory|BotW}} The third and strongest variation, Moblin Gear with the "Dragonbone" modifier, is typically wielded by [[Black Moblin]]s, [[Silver Moblin]]s, and [[Golden Moblin]]s. It's reinforced with fossilized bones, which further increases its attack power and Durability beyond those of Spiked Weapons.{{Cite|{{Big|Dragonbone Moblin Club}}
The bone of an ancient beast has been affixed to this Moblin club, further increasing its damage. Moblins carrying these in battle are particularly dangerous.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Dragonbone Moblin Spear}}
This spear is a fan favorite among Moblins. The spearhead is made from fossilized bones adorned with spikes, which greatly increases its stabbing power.|Inventory|BotW}} As all Moblin Gear is formed around a wooden base, all Weapons within this archetype float when they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. They also burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]], but they do not attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s or conduct [[Electricity]].
